messages:
marco: BlueHarbor support opened a billing dispute — they were overcharged due to an FX adjustment that looks like it was applied twice on INV-2026-0615-775. Theyre asking for a €450 refund.
maria: Thanks. Paste the invoice lines and the exact refund amount requested.
marco: Invoice INV-2026-0615-775 lines: HOSTED-API (Jun) 12,000.00 EUR, FX-ADJUSTMENT 450.00 EUR, TOTAL 12,450.00 EUR. Customer says the FX leg got applied twice during invoice generation and the visible FX-ADJUSTMENT is erroneous. They request a €450.00 refund.
blueharbor-support: Confirmed on our side: payment reconciliation shows the FX charge duplicated in our statement. We only expected the net EUR amount. Screenshot attached.
simon: Ops note: payments pipeline had a conversion step and invoice renderer separately applying FX when currency != account currency. Filing ENG-TASK-2026-130 to prevent double-apply.
maria: Since amount < 5k this is manager-level approval. Need account owner ack and treasury confirmation for EUR refund method.
anna: Account owner here — approved. Customer asks refund to original payment method (card). Please proceed.
treasury-bot: Treasury note: cross-border refunds under €1k can be processed without manual FX hedging. Flag for audit; no extra approvals required.
maria: Approved. Marco, please create a credit memo and issue refund. Suggested commands:
```nbilling-tool credit-create --customer cust_BH23 --invoice INV-2026-0615-775 --amount 450.00 --currency EUR --reason "Erroneous FX adjustment applied" --gl-code REV-ADJ
billing-tool refund-issue --customer cust_BH23 --amount 450.00 --currency EUR --method stripe --note "Refund for erroneous FX adjustment"
```
(Replace with final txn ids once processed)
marco: Created credit memo cm_eu45f and queued refund_txn_eur9; status pending_settlement. ENG-TASK-2026-130 opened and assigned to eng-payments. I'll post settlement id when available.
blueharbor-support: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround and the ENG ticket link.
finance-bot: Ledger note: cm_eu45f recorded for cust_BH23 referencing ENG-TASK-2026-130. Automated policy check passed.
marco: Closing loop here — refund queued, ENG task tracking the root cause. Will reopen if settlement fails."
